She was the daughter of Rodrigo Borja, Count of Palma and Valencia, and Elisabella of Urgell. Roderica is best known for her involvement in the succession crisis following the death of King Jaime I of Aragon in 1276, during which she supported the claims of Pedro III of Aragon against those of his brother, Sancho.

historical_references.context: Roderica of Montferrat was a noblewoman from the House of Montferrat in the Duchy of Milan in the 13th century. She was the wife of Guido I of Nevers, Count of Nevers and Rethel, and was a significant figure in the conflict between the Holy Roman Empire and the Papacy during the Investiture Controversy. Roderica is best known for her role in the Battle of Mons-en-Pevele in 1211, during which she led the Montferrat forces against the imperial army of Otto IV, Holy Roman Emperor. Despite initial successes, the Montferrat army was eventually defeated, and Roderica was captured and held as a prisoner in the castle of Avesnes until her release in 1216.
